faq.q: Can I open a Paraguay company without visiting?
faq.a: Yes. With a notarized power-of-attorney (apostilled), we handle the entire incorporation remotely. You sign via DocuSign from anywhere.

faq.q: What is the territorial tax system?
faq.a: Paraguay taxes only locally-sourced income (10% IRE). Foreign-source income (clients outside PY) is 0%. This makes PY attractive for digital nomads and export-oriented companies.

faq.q: Do I need to become a tax resident?
faq.a: Not always. Tax residency requires 120+ days/year and helps access CDI treaty benefits. We run a qualifier to advise you.

faq.q: How fast can I get a bank account?
faq.a: After EAS is issued, most banks take 5-15 business days. We coordinate intro letters with Itau, Sudameris, Continental and Atlas.

faq.q: Is a Paraguay EAS respected in my home country?
faq.a: EAS is a recognized legal entity under Paraguay's Civil Code and treaties. For home-country CFC/PFIC implications, coordinate with your home tax advisor — we provide all filings needed.

faq.q: What currency do you invoice in?
faq.a: Invoices are issued in Paraguayan Guaraníes (Gs.) per DNIT rules. We publish USD reference pricing and convert at the BCP official rate at billing time.
